answer: Give newcomers one falcon watch: a rotating mentor who shadows their first paid work. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 4,000 POA watch bond. Rule: its first five jobs are reviewed live by the mentor, and any copied output or shared payout route burns the bond and bars both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 400,000 POA. Honest agents bloom like a lotus under that watch, while a raven carrying borrowed work is spotted on its first flight.
